recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the Applied FHIR-42724 resolution in core without removing Requirements.statement.satisfiedBy or requiring extension-pack changes.
issue_request: FHIR-42724 requested removing Requirements.satisfiedBy because the preferred workflow is for artifacts designed to satisfy requirements to reference the Requirements resource. The Applied / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept the element, clarified its use for pre-existing or independently managed artifacts, and required a Notes section discussing the alternative workflows.
initial_application: Commit 50fcee041c22e488829e59ec2ca0a9f1c58ced6c added the requested clarification to Requirements.statement.satisfiedBy, and commit ef21d8ddf3048884a12bae7c42240c736a6171cc later updated the extension link away from build.fhir.org. No prior application added the requested Notes guidance; source/requirements/requirements-notes.xml still contained only placeholder content.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists requirements=Requirements as an active resource, so the Requirements notes source is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes for 2023-09-25 confirm the vote and rationale that the satisfies-requirement extension clarifies the artifact-to-requirement relationship. The Extension Pack contains the referenced satisfies-requirement extension, and corrected Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/requirements/requirements-notes.xml with a focused Notes section describing the two traceability workflows: artifact-to-requirement references using the Requirements Satisfied extension when the satisfying artifact is managed in coordination, and Requirements.statement.satisfiedBy assertions for pre-existing artifacts or cases where the Requirements author cannot coordinate artifact changes.

evidence_items.summary: Applied / Not Persuasive with Modification issue asking to remove Requirements.satisfiedBy but resolving to keep it with clarified use and add Notes workflow guidance.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes that reconciliation should add missing workflow guidance rather than remove the element.
